تمطون (form I)
# تَمُطُّونَ (tamuṭṭūna) /ta.mutˤ.tˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of مَطَّ (maṭṭa)
# تُمَطُّونَ (tumaṭṭūna) /tu.matˤ.tˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of مَطَّ (maṭṭa)
